title: Index: Important Systems
summary: Read the Index signals, states, and failure clues that matter in play.

blocks.title: What To Watch
blocks.body: Categories, entries, recipe cards, relations, source facts, diagnostics, and machine layouts make the same information searchable from different angles.

blocks.title: Player Signals
blocks.body: Watch categories, source facts, recipe cards, machine entries, relation links, favorites, and whether the result belongs to a loaded addon.

blocks.title: Keep It Legible
blocks.body: A Index system is working when another player could look at the state, understand the next action, and avoid the obvious failure.

blocks.title: State Check
blocks.body: Use the system note to read the current state, then choose one action that answers it.
